title: Diagnosing Model--Item Interactions in Language Model Benchmarks with LSIRM
abstract: arXiv:2611.02432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models with similar benchmark accuracy can succeed on different items. Overall scores do not show where their performance differs or which item properties might explain those differences. We demonstrate how the latent space item response model (LSIRM) can help evaluators investigate these patterns and their consequences for model comparison. We analyze 1,348 language models on 5,761 BBH items and compare ways of presenting and scoring answers across BBH, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and MuSR. We examine LSIRM maps, which summarize differences in performance across models and items, alongside item properties and records of correct and incorrect responses. In BBH, nearby items on these maps often share the same correct answer, such as "Yes" or "No." Across the four benchmarks, this pattern is stronger when answers are scored using option labels, such as A, B, C, and D, than when using the text of the options. translated_title: 使用LSIRM诊断语言模型基准测试中的模型-题目交互作用
translated_abstract: 具有相似基准准确率的语言模型可能在不同的题目上取得成功。总体分数无法显示它们的表现究竟在何处存在差异，也无法显示哪些题目属性可能解释这些差异。我们展示了潜在空间项目反应模型（LSIRM）如何帮助评估者研究这些模式及其对模型比较的影响。我们分析了1,348个语言模型在5,761个BBH题目上的表现，并比较了BBH、GPQA、MMLU-Pro和MuSR四个基准中呈现和评分答案的不同方式。我们考察了LSIRM图谱——它总结了模型与题目之间表现的差异——并将其与题目属性以及正确和错误回答的记录相结合进行分析。在BBH中，图谱上相邻的题目往往共享相同的正确答案，例如“是”或“否”。在四个基准测试中，当使用选项标签（如A、B、C、D）对答案进行评分时，这种模式比使用选项文本进行评分时更为明显。随后，我们估计了每个模型的倾向……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文利用潜在空间项目反应模型（LSIRM）将语言模型在基准测试中与题目之间的交互模式可视化，发现图谱上相邻题目常共享相同正确答案，且使用选项标签评分比使用选项文本评分时这一模式更为显著。
en_tdlr: This paper applies the latent space item response model (LSIRM) to diagnose model-item interaction patterns in language model benchmarks, revealing that nearby items on LSIRM maps often share the same correct answer, and that this pattern is stronger when answers are scored using option labels (A, B, C, D) than when using option text.
